'''Kappei Yamaguchi''' (Japanese: '''山口勝平''' ''Yamaguchi Kappei'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}. His real name is '''Mitsuo Yamaguchi''' (Japanese: '''山口光雄''' ''Yamaguchi Mitsuo'') and he was born May 23, 1965 in {{wp|Fukuoka, Fukuoka}}, {{wp|Japan}}. His main role is providing the voice for {{Todd}} (Japanese: トオル ''Tōru'').
